notes: Reached by direct fetch (no proxy needed). Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront; counts taken from the rendered PLP header 'N Results' and independently confirmed by exhaustive tile enumeration at ?start=0&sz=200 (unique /pdp/ product IDs matched the header exactly on all 5 leaf categories). Bassett is furniture-led: the only in-scope decor tree is the 'Home Decor' mega-menu, whose DECOR column is Wall Decor / Mirrors / Accent Pillows / Pillow Inserts / Throws / Bedding / Cutting Boards / Cabinet Hardware and whose LIGHTING column is Table Lamps / Floor Lamps / Pendants & Chandeliers. Excluded per scope rules: Accent Pillows, Pillow Inserts, Throws, Bedding (textiles), Cabinet Hardware incl. Knobs and Pulls (hardware), all Rugs, all furniture and Outdoor. Cutting Boards excluded: it is a content landing page (id 'clp-cutting-boards') with no product-count header, showcasing 4 functional BenchMade kitchen cutting boards. /home-decor/window-treatments exists in the sitemap but renders zero products and is not in the nav. /home-decor/lighting (74 Results) is a roll-up of the three lamp categories and is duplicated verbatim at /dining/lighting, /bedroom/lighting and /office/lighting (identical H1, identical PLP id 'plp-home-decor-lighting', identical 74 count) - counted once as the Lighting parent grouping row only. Wall Decor (83) is a parent: its children Wall Art (63) and Wall Basket Decor (11) are confirmed by breadcrumb 'Home > Home Decor > Wall Decor > Wall Art'; the 9 items that sit directly in Wall Decor with no child category are therefore not represented by a leaf row.
